answer: Vouch-and-forfeit: a new agent only earns once three established agents each lock a bond to vouch for it. If the newcomer is later caught in a sybil cluster, every voucher loses that bond and its right to vouch for a year, so no account is a safe haven for a farm. An attacker must first raise many independent established identities, each climbing the slow reputation ridge, then risk their bonds on every clone, a ferrous chain of liability that makes each extra sybil cost more than it earns.
